title: USS Abraham Lincoln Sailors Attempted to Jump Overboard Amid Mental Health Crisis
summary: Six sailors aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln reportedly attempted to jump overboard due to mental health issues stemming from a prolonged 9-month deployment at sea. The incidents occurred amid critical conditions and limited access to land, leading to increased scrutiny and demands for accountability from lawmakers regarding the crew's treatment.
summary_points: Six sailors aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln attempted to jump overboard.
The attempts are linked to mental health crises and prolonged deployment.
The ship has been at sea for over 260 days.
Lawmakers are demanding accountability for the crew's treatment.
Limited access to land contributed to the sailors' stress.

summary_points_hi: यूएसएस अब्राहम लिंकन पर सवार छह नाविकों ने जहाज से कूदने का प्रयास किया।
ये प्रयास मानसिक स्वास्थ्य संकट और लंबी तैनाती से जुड़े हैं।
जहाज 260 दिनों से अधिक समय से समुद्र में है।
सांसद चालक दल के इलाज के लिए जवाबदेही की मांग कर रहे हैं।
